fields.title: MDN Algeria tender notice record
fields.description: One record per notice (one PDF attachment) published under one calendar day's accordion section. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when the page fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which mode this record came from: 'mode:latest' or 'mode:archived'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-mdn-accordion-current, S1-mdn-accordion-archive, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

date.title: Publication date
date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the notice was published under, parsed from the French accordion header. Null if the date text didn't match the expected 'DD Month YYYY' pattern.

dateRaw.title: Publication date (raw)
dateRaw.description: The original French accordion header text, e.g. '24 Août 2026'.

noticeType.title: Notice type
noticeType.description: Best-effort classification from keywords in the notice text: TENDER_NOTICE, DEADLINE_EXTENSION_NOTICE, AWARD_NOTICE, PROVISIONAL_AWARD_NOTICE, UNSUCCESSFUL_TENDER_NOTICE, CANCELLATION_NOTICE, CORRIGENDUM_NOTICE, DEFAULT_NOTICE (mise en demeure -- formal notice against a contractor in breach), CONSULTATION_NOTICE, or OTHER.

reference.title: Reference number
reference.description: Best-effort extraction of the tender/notice reference number following 'N°' in the text, e.g. '158/2026/D4/T/5°RM'. Null if no 'N°' pattern was found.

description.title: Full notice text
description.description: The complete notice text as published (French), HTML-unescaped and whitespace-normalized. This is the authoritative field; noticeType/reference are best-effort conveniences derived from it.

pdfUrl.title: PDF URL
pdfUrl.description: Absolute URL to the official notice/attachment PDF hosted on mdn.dz.
